query:
INSERT INTO envelope (id, tenant_id, state, doc)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
            ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
            SET tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id,
                state = EXCLUDED.state,
                doc = EXCLUDED.doc,
                updated_at = now()
            RETURNING
                id,
                tenant_id,
                state,
                doc as "doc!: Json<Value>"
